name: lg_epoch_eot
doc: Jackie's ch27 (loc 1DA, Lavos's outer shell) out by the Epoch: left 90 frames to it (obj12 at tile (5,60)), A -- its fn1 clears glb[170] bit 4 (57 -> 47), sets glb[171] bit 7 and $02AF = 01D9, and CHANGELOC 1D0: the End of Time, storyline D6, the Epoch parked at 1D9. Its story bytes are the owner's Epoch capture's (saves/epoch_re/epoch_user, 1000 A.D.) but for two flags ($7F00AB bit 7, $7F00CD).
